text:
opsbot: [ALERT] sa-east1: text-gen p95 latency up ~2.1x for the last 12m; error budget creeping. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/sa-east1/text-gen
leila: looking now — seeing noise across hotpool pods in sa-east1. KV cache hit rate dropped 98% -> 66%
hugo: rolling back runtime commit 7a3b (scheduler tweak) to 7a2f across sa-east1, starting canary
devin: noticed batch sizes jumped to 64+ on many nodes at p50, tails look spiky. could be coalescing change
leila: yep, continuous-batcher cross-tenant coalescing seems to be merging prefixes unexpectedly after the sched tweak
sam: small traffic-override to na1 is live (5%) from earlier experiments — we can push more if needed
leila: mitigation plan: (1) disable cross-tenant coalescing, (2) scale hotpool +20% in sa-east1, (3) warm KV cache
jen: commands I'm running now:
kubectl -n runtime set env deployment/batcher CROSS_TENANT_COALESCE=false
kubectl -n infra-sa-east1 scale deployment/hotpool --replicas=12
runtime-bot: rollback 7a3b -> 7a2f applied: 6/6 pods updated (sa-east1)
hugo: p95 trending down after rollback but KV hit still low; starting cache-warm job to repopulate prefixes
devin: cache-warm snippet we used:
for pod in $(cat hotpods); do ssh $pod 'curl -s "http://localhost:8080/warm?src=recent_traces"' & done
tanya: increasing na1 traffic to 15% temporarily to shave p95 while caches rebuild: /infra/traffic-router set sa-east1->na1 0.15
leila: note on costs — scaling hotpool + cross-region routing will increase egress and GPU duty. Ops approved emergency spend for now :warning:
jen: tracking cost delta in incident doc (link: https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/PM-2273)
leila: KV hit recovered to ~90% within 8m, p95 near baseline; keeping batching coalescing disabled until root cause confirmed
hugo: filing RCA ticket and scheduling follow-up with runtime/batcher teams to validate interaction between scheduler and batcher eviction heuristics
sam: awesome response, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
__notes: No title per agents.md; single continuous thread string; short/slackty messages; includes bots and commands
